name: snapshot-dashboard
description: A static dark-themed dashboard for snapshot data using Plotly.

scripts.copy-static: cp index.html js/ && cp -r css js/ && cp -r assets js/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.copy-static:windows: xcopy /Y index.html js\ && xcopy /Y /S /I css js\css && if exist assets xcopy /Y /S /I assets js\assets
